findings.title: Fallback call crashes for users with get_session_auth_hash but no fallback method
findings.suggested_fix: Resolve fallback hashes defensively, e.g. getattr(user, 'get_session_auth_fallback_hash', lambda: ())(), so user models lacking the new method fall through to flush() as before.

residual_risks: Custom user models overriding get_session_auth_hash() but inheriting the default get_session_auth_fallback_hash() never match on fallback; sessions still invalidated on key rotation (fails safe).
testing_gaps: No test for a session hash matching neither current secret nor any fallback (should flush).
No test for missing session hash with fallbacks configured, or a user lacking get_session_auth_fallback_hash.

residual_risks: django/contrib/auth/__init__.py: duck-typed user with get_session_auth_hash but no fallback method raises AttributeError (HTTP 500) on stale session; fails closed.
Overrides of get_session_auth_hash are not covered by fallback (private _get_session_auth_hash); fails closed.
Any secret left in SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS can still validate session hashes until removed (inherent to the feature).
testing_gaps: No test that non-matching hash is flushed when SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS non-empty.
No test that missing/empty session hash flushes with fallbacks configured.

findings.title: Duck-typed user without fallback method: hash mismatch raises AttributeError instead of flushing
findings.suggested_fix: Use getattr(user, 'get_session_auth_fallback_hash', lambda: ())() or an explicit hasattr check.

residual_risks: Custom user models overriding get_session_auth_hash() are not covered by fallback; sessions still invalidated on key rotation (fails closed).
cycle_key() deletes the old session row immediately; parallel requests carrying the old cookie after rotation may see an anonymous session (transient logout). Not confirmed with a test.
testing_gaps: No test covers stale/invalid session hash with SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS set, password change with fallbacks, or a hash matching no fallback.

findings.title: No test that a non-matching hash still flushes with fallbacks configured
findings.suggested_fix: Add TestGetUser test: login, then under override_settings(SECRET_KEY='newsecret', SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS=['unrelated']) assert AnonymousUser and flushed session; add variants for missing HASH_SESSION_KEY.
findings.first_evidence: django/contrib/auth/__init__.py:39-40 -- request.session.flush(); user = None (else branch under any(...) with fallbacks, untested)

findings.title: Fallback test does not assert the stored session hash was rewritten
findings.suggested_fix: After first get_user(), assert request.session[HASH_SESSION_KEY] equals user.get_session_auth_hash() under the new SECRET_KEY.

residual_risks: No test for duck-typed user models lacking get_session_auth_fallback_hash on mismatch.
get_session_auth_hash overrides are not exercised with fallback secrets.
testing_gaps: Empty/missing HASH_SESSION_KEY with SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS set is untested.

findings.title: get_user() now requires new method on every user model with session hash
findings.suggested_fix: Resolve fallback hashes defensively, e.g. getattr(user, 'get_session_auth_fallback_hash', lambda: ())(), so user models lacking the new method fall through to flush() as before. Note: reviewer cited line 215 (working-tree estimate); the call site is django/contrib/auth/__init__.py:34 of the new hunk (~line 215 of the file).

residual_risks: Overrides of get_session_auth_hash() not covered by SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS; docs don't tell authors to override both.
New public method added in a patch release (4.1.8) with versionadded; subclasses already defining a same-named method would be affected.
testing_gaps: No test for duck-typed user model lacking the fallback method, nor an AbstractBaseUser subclass overriding get_session_auth_hash under fallbacks.
